_comment: Tier-2 for skfem mixed_poisson#6: the reference-domain normal arrays are NOT unit length on slanted facets. Measured on skfem 12.0.1: RefTri norms [1, sqrt(2), 1], RefTet [1, 1, 1, sqrt(3)], RefWedge [1, sqrt(2), 1, 1, 1]; RefLine/RefQuad/RefHex all unit; and RefWedge.brefdom is None, uniquely among the 3-D refdoms. FINDING: the claim's stated workaround names 'FacetBasis.normal', which does not exist -- the attribute is FacetBasis.normalS, and that one IS unit length. The fixture pins the correct name.
